environment.description: Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate task in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d4e5f. Subnet route table rtb-0f9e8d7c6b5a has local route only (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with NO NAT gateway, NO VPC endpoint for S3/SSM, and NO internet gateway attachment. The only ingress path is via internal ALB (scheme=internal) on port 8080 restricted to CIDR 10.0.0.0/16. ECS task networking mode is 'awsvpc' with ENI in the private subnet. DNS resolution within VPC resolves only internal Route53 private hosted zone entries. Task execution role has no network-related permissions. Fargate platform version 1.4.0 with default seccomp profile applied.
